mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained FEDFUNDS above 2.5% for 3 months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in HOUST and RSAFS indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, increasing wage pressures and corporate costs, which reduces profit margins and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 105.0 indicates robust industrial output growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 3.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market tightness, prompting imminent monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in RSAFS and HOUST signals strong consumer spending and housing activity, boosting revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint growth in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5% for 3 months triggers monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with sustained FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
